title: Audio & ARIA announcement patterns for interactive charts and dense tables
creator: Marisol Chen
description: Goal: Provide a consistent, low-noise announcement pattern for interactive canvas/SVG charts and for dense/tabular data with nested interactive controls. This ticket captures design decisions for ARIA roles, live-region semantics, optional audio cues, keyboard traversal for cell-level actions, and the token contrast ramp needed for compact density variants. Background: During the last accessibility audit we found three recurring issues: 1) canvas charts lacked an accessible short summary and had no deterministic announcement behavior when values changed, 2) dense tables with inline action menus and virtualized rows had inconsistent focus and keyboard traps, 3) several color token variants in compact density fell below WCAG AA for text-on-background. Scope: Design micro-patterns for 1) chart summaries + change announcements (user-configurable), 2) table cell roving focus with consistent ARIA roles for cell-level menus and custom controls, and 3) token adjustments and migration guidance for contrast improvements. Exclusions: This ticket does not include engineering rollout orchestration, backfill of telemetry dashboards, or integration work with third-party chart libraries beyond providing adapter guidance. Proposed solution: - Charts: Add an offscreen, update-batched aria-live region tied to chart focus and to a "summary" button; provide two announcement modes (brief and verbose). For high-frequency updates (streaming charts) default to threshold-based summaries (e.g., announce when delta > 5% or on user-trigger). Provide a11y API for engineers to call with structured summary strings. - Audio: Provide optional short audio cue assets (on by opt-in only) and explicit preference in Console accessibility settings; default remains silent announcements. - Tables: Implement roving tabindex pattern across interactive cells; each interactive cell exposes an aria-haspopup / aria-controls linkage for menus; support keyboard shortcuts to open cell actions (Enter/Space) and arrow navigation to move between cells. Provide guidance for virtualized lists to maintain DOM focus anchor. - Tokens/Contrast: Introduce a compact-density contrast ramp with three elevated contrast tokens (cd-text-primary, cd-text-strong, cd-bg-elevated) and a migration guide mapping old tokens to new ones. Acceptance criteria, design artifacts, annotated Figma components, and a VPAT evidence checklist are included below.
acceptance_criteria: Design spec with annotated Figma components: chart component + summary button + aria-live region
Table component spec demonstrating roving tabindex and explicit aria-* attributes for cell actions
Contrast token diff and migration guidance document mapping old -> new tokens
VPAT evidence checklist completed for charts and tables (screenshots, narrative, ARIA mapping)
Engineering hooks documented (API examples for announce(summaryString, options))
QA checklist and automated axe/core-a11y test cases defined for each pattern
qa_checklist: Keyboard: Tab/Shift+Tab moves focus predictably between table controls and chart summary button
Keyboard: Arrow keys move focus between cells in dense table and open/close cell menus with Enter/Escape
Screen reader: Chart summary is read on focus and when a programmatic announce is triggered
Screen reader: Live-region updates are throttled to avoid spam for streaming data (threshold behavior validated)
Contrast: Compact density token values meet WCAG AA for normal text and AA/AAA where required for small text
Regression: Existing components retain visual parity unless token migration flag enabled
comments: 2025-11-04 Marisol Chen: Created ticket after weekly accessibility review. Noted priority on VPAT readiness for upcoming enterprise audit. Assigned to Alejandro for pattern drafts.

2025-11-07 Alejandro Ruiz: Initial exploration completed. Two options for charts: 1) centralized live-region per page, 2) per-component live-region. Leaning toward per-component to allow scoped summaries and easier opt-in. Draft figma frames uploaded (attachment).

2025-11-10 Accessibility review (Lena Park): Per-component live-region preferred to avoid cross-chart noise. Recommend default mode: brief announcements + settings toggle for verbose mode. Raised concern about audio cues being disruptive for screen reader users; suggest audio opt-in only.

2025-11-12 Alejandro Ruiz: Updated Figma with compact-density token suggestions and annotated export-ready token names. Proposed cd-text-primary = #1F2937, cd-text-strong = #111827, cd-bg-elevated = #F8FAFC. Added migration notes recommending feature-flag rollout to avoid sudden visual changes.

2025-11-15 PM review (Dana Sokolov): Approved acceptance criteria; asked to include explicit guidance for virtualized tables used in logs/metrics pages. Added DES-74015 as follow-up for engineering adapters.

2025-11-18 Alejandro Ruiz: RFC posted in design-system channel summarizing performance trade-offs for live-region batching. Proposal: announce only when user focuses chart or when threshold exceeded; include a developer opt-in for streaming announcements. Seeking eng feedback.

2025-11-20 Eng feedback (Priya Nair): Engineering concerned about extra DOM nodes in high-density dashboards. Suggest using a single per-route live-region with component registration. We will capture both options in spec and let eng choose implementation path per product.

2025-11-24 Marisol Chen: Consolidated spec and updated VPAT evidence checklist. Ready for design review board next week. Marking ticket In Progress with a small dev spike (DES-74015) to validate adapter approach.
release_notes: Adds accessibility announcement patterns for charts and robust keyboard navigation for dense tables. Introduces compact-density contrast token ramp and migration guidance. Charts: configurable announcement modes (brief/verbose) and optional audio cues (opt-in). Tables: roving tabindex and explicit ARIA for cell actions. See VPAT evidence for details.
notes_for_engineering: Support per-component or per-route live-region strategy; include registration API if per-route chosen
Expose token migration flag (design-system:cd-contrast-migration) to toggle new compact-density tokens
Avoid automatic audio playback unless user has explicitly enabled audio cues in Console accessibility settings
